name: A word on the elevator
content:
A WORD ON THE ELEVATOR

This note is a reminder for staff to avoid using the maintenance elevator leading to the old and abandoned underground tunnels. These areas are not only unsafe but also outside of our remit. It is a criminal offence to trespass on those areas. Furthermore, the elevator has not been serviced in a considerable period of time and is likely unsafe to operate.

.This is a final warning, do not use the elevator again.

.Captain Hanson, security detail.
